evidence.quote: Problem 12.2.1 Let M ⊂ P n be a compact odd dimensional CR manifold. Find conditions on M which ensure that M bounds a complex variety.(This is well understood in Cn .) -N.Sibony, sibony@anh.matups.fr 12.3 Quasiconformal mappings

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{P}^n$ denote complex projective $n$-space, and let $M \subset \mathbb{P}^n$ be a compact, smooth, odd-dimensional CR submanifold (i.e., a real submanifold whose tangent spaces carry a CR structure: a complex subbundle $T^{1,0}M \subset T_{\mathbb{C}}M$ with $T^{1,0}M \cap \overline{T^{1,0}M} = 0$ and $[T^{1,0}M, T^{1,0}M] \subset T^{1,0}M$). We say that $M$ "bounds a complex variety" if there exists a complex analytic subvariety (or a holomorphic chain) $V \subset \mathbb{P}^n \setminus M$ of complex dimension $(\dim_{\mathbb{R}} M + 1)/2$, with finite volume, whose boundary (as a current of integration) equals $[M]$ (or an integer multiple of $[M]$).

The analogous problem in $\mathbb{C}^n$ admits a complete solution (the Harvey–Lawson moment condition for maximally complex CR submanifolds). 

Find geometric and analytic conditions on the compact odd-dimensional CR submanifold $M \subset \mathbb{P}^n$ that are necessary and sufficient for $M$ to bound a complex subvariety (holomorphic chain) of $\mathbb{P}^n$.
artifact.category_tag: CR geometry and boundaries of complex varieties
artifact.status_search_result: Substantial progress has been made: Dolbeault and Henkin ("Chaînes holomorphes de bord donné dans $\mathbb{C}P^n$", Bull. Soc. Math. France, 1997) gave conditions characterizing when a maximally complex CR cycle in $\mathbb{P}^n$ bounds a holomorphic chain, using a projective analogue of the Harvey–Lawson moment condition. Further refinements and extensions (e.g., Harvey–Lawson, and more recent works on reconstruction of Riemann surfaces with given boundary in $\mathbb{C}P^n$) continue. Thus the problem is partially solved in important cases but a fully general characterization remains an active research direction.

status_evidence.title: Chaînes holomorphes de bord donné dans CP^n
status_evidence.snippet: Dolbeault–Henkin characterize CR cycles in complex projective space that bound holomorphic chains.
status_evidence.claim: Gives conditions under which maximally complex CR cycles in CP^n bound holomorphic chains, addressing the projective analogue of Harvey–Lawson.

status_evidence.title: Explicit Reconstruction of Riemann Surface with Given Boundary in Complex Projective Space
status_evidence.snippet: Treats reconstruction of Riemann surfaces with prescribed boundary in CP^n, continuing the Dolbeault–Henkin program.
status_evidence.claim: Indicates ongoing research and partial progress on bounding complex varieties from CR submanifolds in projective space.
